title: Journalist & Whistleblower Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Assess your privacy risk level as a journalist or whistleblower. Get personalized security recommendations to protect sources and communications.
description: Evaluate your digital privacy risks and get tailored security recommendations for protecting sources, communications, and sensitive information as a journalist or whistleblower.

formula: const riskWeights = { workType: { 'local-news': 10, 'investigative': 25, 'foreign-correspondent': 30, 'freelance': 20, 'whistleblower': 35 }, sensitiveTopics: { 'low': 5, 'moderate': 15, 'high': 30, 'extreme': 40 }, location: { 'democratic': 5, 'restricted': 20, 'authoritarian': 35, 'conflict-zone': 40 }, communicationMethods: { 'insecure': 25, 'mixed': 15, 'secure': 5, 'advanced': -5 }, deviceSecurity: { 'poor': 20, 'basic': 10, 'good': -5, 'excellent': -15 }, sourceProtection: { 'minimal': 20, 'standard': 10, 'advanced': -5, 'expert': -15 }, targetProfile: { 'low': 5, 'moderate': 15, 'high': 25, 'very-high': 35 } }; let score = Object.keys(riskWeights).reduce((total, key) => total + (riskWeights[key][inputs[key]] || 0), 0); score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score)); const level = score >= 70 ? 'Critical' : score >= 50 ? 'High' : score >= 30 ? 'Moderate' : 'Low'; const threats = []; if (inputs.workType === 'whistleblower') threats.push('retaliation', 'legal action'); if (inputs.sensitiveTopics === 'high' || inputs.sensitiveTopics === 'extreme') threats.push('surveillance', 'intimidation'); if (inputs.location === 'authoritarian' || inputs.location === 'conflict-zone') threats.push('arrest', 'violence'); if (inputs.communicationMethods === 'insecure') threats.push('communication interception'); const recs = []; if (inputs.deviceSecurity === 'poor' || inputs.deviceSecurity === 'basic') recs.push('Upgrade device security with full encryption and Incognito Browser'); if (inputs.communicationMethods === 'insecure' || inputs.communicationMethods === 'mixed') recs.push('Switch to encrypted messaging and secure email'); if (inputs.sourceProtection === 'minimal' || inputs.sourceProtection === 'standard') recs.push('Implement SecureDrop or similar anonymous communication systems'); if (score >= 50) recs.push('Consider using Tor network and VPN for all communications'); return { riskScore: score, riskLevel: level, primaryThreats: threats.join(', ') || 'Digital surveillance, source exposure', recommendations: recs.slice(0, 3).join('; ') || 'Continue current security practices' };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy risks based on your work type, operating environment, security practices, and threat exposure. It considers factors like geographic location, topic sensitivity, communication methods, and existing security measures to provide a comprehensive risk assessment.
tips: Use Incognito Browser or Tor Browser for research on sensitive topics
Set up SecureDrop or similar systems for anonymous source communication
Use burner phones and devices for high-risk communications
Regularly update all devices and use full disk encryption
Consider operational security (OPSEC) training for high-risk situations
Develop secure backup and storage systems for sensitive materials
Use VPN services that don't log user activity
Practice digital hygiene: separate work and personal accounts
